(pg 84) Pre-made food.
You do not gain the benefits or the effects of any foods until after 1 minute (pg 82). Consuming any food removes one level of hunger.
Spoiled: Cooked food becomes spoiled after 3 days, and any food that remains in an irradiated zone for more than an hour becomes spoiled. If you eat spoiled food, you contract dysentery. (pg 82)
Filling: If you consume food with this property, you remove another level of hunger. (pg 83)
Tasty: If you consume a food with this property, you heal a number of stamina points equal to your level. (pg 83)
Irradiated: Some foods aren't entirely the safest to eat, but beggars can't be choosers in the wasteland. When you consume a food that is irradiated, you gain one irradiated level. If you gain ten irradiated levels, you gain one level of rads. (pg 83)
